search_placeholder.context: Placeholder in the search field (tap the search pill in Plan)

search_clear_query.context: Content description (accessibility) of the x in the search field

search_clear_recent.context: Text button next to 'Recent': clears the list of recent searches

search_intro.context: Hint shown in an empty search screen without recent searches

search_nothing_of_kind.context: A category chip is chosen but the offline map has nothing of that kind

search_no_match.context: No offline result for the typed text

search_online_attribution.context: Small line under online results (licence credit)

search_searching_online.context: Small grey line while online results load

search_in_google.context: Last row of the results: hand the query to Google Maps. %1$s = typed text (German quotes „…“)

search_google_line.context: Second line of the Google Maps row

search_preparing.context: Spinner text the very first time the offline search index is built

search_near_route.context: Part of a result's second line ('Mountain hut · 2325 m · 3.4 km · near your route')

search_online.context: Part of a result's second line: the result came from the online search

search_cat_huts.context: Category chip under the search field

search_cat_peaks.context: Category chip under the search field

search_cat_water.context: Category chip: drinking water, springs, waterfalls

search_cat_stations.context: Category chip: train stations, lift stations, bus stops

search_kind_peak.context: Kind of a search result / place card (natural=peak)

search_kind_place.context: Kind: a place (town / village) when no finer class is known; also any unnamed unknown place

search_kind_store.context: Kind: a shop from the online search

search_place_city.context: Kind of a place result: city

search_place_town.context: Kind of a place result: town

search_place_village.context: Kind of a place result: village

search_place_hamlet.context: Kind of a place result: hamlet

search_place_suburb.context: Kind of a place result: suburb (OSM place=suburb)

search_place_neighbourhood.context: Kind of a place result: neighbourhood

search_place_quarter.context: Kind of a place result: quarter

search_place_isolated_dwelling.context: Kind of a place result: a single farm or house

search_place_locality.context: Kind of a place result: named area without houses (OSM place=locality)
search_place_locality.doubt: 'Flur / Örtlichkeit' kept from the earlier German label

search_card_add.context: Main button of the place card (search result or tapped POI); the line under it says what it does

search_card_remove.context: Main button when the place already is a route point

search_card_as_start.context: Small button: make the place the start

search_card_as_destination.context: Small button: make the place the destination

search_add_as_start.context: Line under 'Add to route': the place will become the start

search_add_as_destination.context: Line under 'Add to route': the place will be the destination (route has one point)

search_add_as_new_destination.context: Line under 'Add to route': the place becomes the new destination; followed by ' · about +0.9 km, +15 min'

search_add_as_stop_on_route.context: Line under 'Add to route': %1$d = number of the stop; the place lies on the route
search_add_as_stop_on_route.doubt: 'Stopp' for a via point (glossary says Zwischenpunkt, which is too long here)

search_add_as_stop_best.context: Line under 'Add to route': %1$d = stop number, where it fits best; followed by the detour

search_add_about.context: Detour estimate after ' · ': %1$s = '+0.9 km, +15 min' (distance and time, built in code)

search_is_start.context: Line under 'Remove from route': the place is the start

search_is_destination.context: Line under 'Remove from route': the place is the destination

search_is_stop.context: Line under 'Remove from route': %1$d = stop number

search_note_from_address.context: Note that stays on the card of a place shared from Google Maps when its position came from the address search (may be off)

search_route_round_to.context: Suggested name of a round trip without a known start: %1$s = the farthest landmark. Saved into the route name (data once saved)
search_route_round_to.doubt: German preposition depends on the place ('zur Hütte', 'auf den Gipfel'); 'zu' is neutral but reads stiff

search_route_round_from.context: Suggested name of a round trip: %1$s = start place ('Round trip from Algund')

search_route_from.context: Suggested route name when only the start is known: %1$s = start place

search_route_to.context: Suggested route name when only the destination is known: %1$s = destination
search_route_to.doubt: 'Nach' fits towns; for huts/peaks 'Zur …'/'Auf …' would be better German

search_route_via.context: Route name with a via stop: %1$s = 'Algund → Hochmuth', %2$s = the via stop ('Leiter Alm')
